body.x: Step into the expo, and the first thing to greet you will be the booths of Samsung Electronics and LG Electronics. The two companies have the biggest delegations at the entire show, reflecting the huge importance of both companies, which are towering pillars in the electronics industry both in Korea and overseas.

Constantly jockeying for position at the head of the pack, Samsung and LG have brought a similar number of products for visitors to peruse. However, look closely and you may notice a slight difference in the attitude of the two industry giants. In the TV field, Samsung is hoping to wow visitors with the release of the Smart TV ES8000, a futuristic TV that can understand users’ voices and hand gestures. LG offers its own charm with an OLED TV that boasts an ultra-slim design that is thinner than a smart phone while still offering crystal-clear resolution.

In the smartphone category, we can witness the fierce PR battle between the two rivals which has spilled over from last year. The two frontrunners in the race are Samsung’s Galaxy SIII and LG’s Optimus G. The Galaxy SIII aims to produce a human-centered user environment powered by high-performance quadcore processors, while the Optimus G adds high-definition True HD IPS+ display to a revolutionary design with no frame around the screen.

And not only that, but both companies haven’t forgotten to bring along their stock of electronics and household appliances, with PCs, printers, refrigerators, and vacuum cleaners in the catalogue. It’s sure to give visitors to the KES 2012 an unforgettable experience.
